newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed at auction.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields mixed at auction.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, six-month Ukraine discount treasury bills rose, yields on nine-month bills were unchanged and 12-month T-bills yields slipped from previous sales, a central bank statement said on Thursday.

Three-month bills edged up to 21.15 percent from 21.11 percent, six-month bills firmed to 23.70 percent from 23.58 percent, nine-month bills remained at 28.83 percent and 12-month bills slipped to 32.89 percent from 32.91 percent.
The results of Wednesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 5.00 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Amount sold 4.49 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.26 million UAH 4.75 million UAH
The central bank sold 44,859 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 23,361 were competitive and 21,498 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
Results of six-month T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 9.00 million UAH 9.00 million UAH
Amount sold 7.86 million UAH 7.83 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.03 million UAH 7.01 million UAH
The central bank sold 78,583 T-bills, the bank statement said. Of those, 58,653 were competitive and 19,930 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 22.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 13.00 million UAH 30.00 million UAH
Amount sold 9.32 million UAH 10.89 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.67 million UAH 8.96 million UAH
The central bank sold 93,231 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 81,052 were competitive and 12,179 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 22.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH 37.00 million UAH
Amount sold 20.00 million UAH 29.89 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.06 million UAH 22.50 million UAH
The central bank sold 200,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 151,873 were competitive and 48,127 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 22.
